capability: Ask for one method, not one answer
title: One line for every puzzle.

hook.picture: Close on puzzle cards; the whale improvises a wavering line through the first one and a pod answers ✕ (rust chip).
hook.words: Wrong again, and wrong a new way.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It gets the same kind of puzzle wrong, differently each time.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: researcher rerunning the same puzzle set

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three new cards, three new improvised lines, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½; two answer ✕.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: It guesses each one from scratch.

stakes.body: Results change run to run, so nothing can be compared or trusted.

solution_hint: Ask for one method that solves all.

metaphor.body: Instead of a fresh wavering line per card, the whale draws one careful line once, and every card runs along it and comes out ticked.

steps.picture: The whale draws one careful line once, slowly, from edge to edge.
Push-in: the cards slide onto the line one after another; each comes out the far end with a tick.
steps.words: Every puzzle runs through the same line.

steps.picture: The line itself shows as a small program the pod wrote once, not an answer per card.
steps.words: Here the method is a small program.

steps.picture: The line sits labelled under the ticked cards.
steps.words: The prompt asked for a method: meta-prompting.

real_case.claim: The repo README reports Game of 24 results: GPT-4 zero-shot 4%, chain-of-thought 36%, categorical meta-prompting 100%. No method is shown for the 100%.

honest_limit.picture: An open question card (wavy lines inside, no dots) slides toward the method line, does not fit, and gets no tick. The whale is guessing again.
honest_limit.words: Open questions have no single method.

not_this.body: Not a fix for questions without checks.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot: the same four puzzle cards from bar 1 slide along the one line; four ticks land in a row, on the beat.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT each card got its own wavering guess and two failed; the same four cards now share one line and all tick.

end_belief.body: Checkable task? Ask for the method, not answers.
